question: Sonal Mansingh is a prominent Indian classical dancer who specialises in _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bharatanatyam and Odissi.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__****Sonal Mansingh**

__
 
• Indian classical dancer and **Guru Bharatanatyam and Odissi **dancing style.
 
• She is a teacher, researcher, choreographer, and social activist.
 
• Also Nominated by the **President of India to become a Member of Parliament, Rajya Sabha**.
 
• She is the **youngest recipient of Padma Bhushan in 1992** and** Padma Vibhushan in 2003.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bala Saraswati** is the **queen of Bharatnatyam.**
 
• **Kelucharan Mohapatra** was a **legendary Indian classical dancer, guru, and exponent of Odissi dance**
 
 
• **​**She is credited with the **revival and popularizing of this classical dance form in the 20th century.**
 
 
 
• **Guru Pankaj Charan Das** was an Indian classical dancer, choreographer and the Adi Guru of Odissi dance.
 
 
• He is known as the **Father of Odissi dance**.
